environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a private VPC subnet. The container runs as root with full filesystem access. The HTTP endpoint is exposed via an internal ALB (scheme=internal) accessible from other services in the VPC. No WAF is attached to the ALB. Kafka topic accepts messages from any producer with valid SASL credentials. The container filesystem includes /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, and application secrets at /var/secrets/.
